Our Products

Beiwe

Beiwe is a clinical management platform. It was designed with the help of specialists in Psychology and Occupational Therapy and, as such, tailored to their daily needs. Since it runs in the browser, you can use it from your computer, tablet or phone, wherever you are, with nothing to install. It provides:

  • 📅

    Agenda: An efficient agenda to keep track of your patients' appointments, synced with Google Calendar so your schedule is always at hand.

  • 👥

    Patient records: Complete patient profiles, including guardian information, which is essential when working with children and adolescents.

  • 👩‍⚕️

    Team & locations: Bring your whole team on board. Each professional gets their own access, all under one clinic account, even if you work across multiple offices.

  • 💰

    Finances: Everything you need to keep a healthy, controlled cash flow:

    • Accounting: A clean view of your costs and revenue, with charts and reports that add transparency to your business practice.
    • Multi-currency: Have patients abroad? Charge and track payments in different currencies without mixing up your numbers.
    • Invoices: Generate invoices and keep track of your finances throughout the year. (Your accountant will thank you 😊)
  • 📋

    Reports & documents: Professional documents, every time:

    • Consistent templates: Forget about documents changing format all the time — you'll have consistent designs and templates to choose from.
    • Digital signatures: Sign your reports digitally, with a trusted timestamp that proves when they were signed and that they haven't been altered since. Ready to send to schools, doctors, courts or health insurers.
  • 🤖🎙️

    Voice transcriptions: Do you still type reports after every session? Now you can transcribe them using your voice instead. Even better: Beiwe uses AI to automatically parse your speech into the document sections you've previously defined.

  • ☁️🔒

    Secure cloud storage: Do you remember the last time you needed a patient report and it was on the phone of a collaborator who was on vacation, with no way to reach her? We solve this too: all your documents are stored in one clean, organized place, accessible from any device, anywhere. And because your patients' data is sensitive, we treat it that way: every clinic's files are encrypted with their own key, and personal information is encrypted in our database too, in line with the LGPD.

  • 🔔

    Reminders: Several reminders that help you and your team provide all that you can to your patients.

📩 Want to see it in action? Get in touch at contato@kukaisolutions.com and schedule a demo.
